name: get_operation
description:
Gets the status of a long-running operation.

**Usage**

Some tools return a long-running operation.
You can use this tool to get the status of the operation.
If an operation takes an extended amount of time,
then wait at least 5 seconds before rechecking the status of the operation.

parameters.description: Request message for GetOperation. The fields project_id, location, and operation_id combine to form the full resource name of the operation: `projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/operations/{operation_id}`. This should be the name returned by the tool that initiated the operation.

location.description: Required. The Google Cloud location (region) of the operation.

operationId.description: Required. The unique identifier of the operation to get, which was returned by the tool that initiated the operation.

projectId.description: Required. The ID of the Google Cloud project containing the operation.
